description: Reinforcement Learning for Distribution Grid Optimization (PyCIGAR) v0.1 is a model or code deposit deposited in DOE Office of Scientific and Technical Information (OSTI) Repository by its authors Daniel Arnold, Ciaran Roberts (Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory (LBNL), Berkeley, CA (United States)). PyCIGAR is a python software package that merges off-the-shelf reinforcement learning libraries (RLLib and Ray) with electric power distribution system simulation tools (OpenDSS and a custom power flow solver built by LBL). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT.
